## Primary: buffered/shared, local schedulers (campaign "main")

No trials of the main campaign yet.

- A,E before C: same cost, strictly higher fee: every fee-aware rule agrees (positive control).
- A,E before F: same price and fee, F costs 8x: only a cost denominator puts A and E first.
- C before B: reward/cost with half the base fee (both clients' source) puts C first; prio fee/cost, price and total fee put B first.
- D before C: reward/cost with half the base fee puts D first; counting the whole base fee, or cost alone, would put C first.
- A before B: every per-unit rule puts A first; total fee puts B first.
